title: Install and Verify a Universal Forwarder
track: Forwarders, Deployment Server, and Heavy Forwarders
objectives: Install and Verify a Universal Forwarder
Verify actual configuration, delivery and resulting operational behavior.

tasks.instruction: This isolated attempt starts paused. Use Forwarder Management to inspect clients/apps/classes, or Terminal SSH from the bastion. Linux UF: ssh splunk@lab-lnx-0001. Automation: ssh svc_ansible@ansible01 then cd ~/splunk-automation. Administrative changes and packages are entirely simulated.

On lab-lnx-0001 inspect rpm -q splunkforwarder and rpm -K /opt/staging/splunkforwarder-9.4.1-simulated.x86_64.rpm. Install with sudo rpm -ivh PACKAGE, start /opt/splunkforwarder/bin/splunk start --accept-license --answer-yes --no-prompt, and enable boot-start as splunk. Forwarder Management client controls offer the same teaching workflow. Verify version, owner and running service independently. These are virtual teaching artifacts, not vendor-signed RPM binaries.

After the required activation, select the client in Forwarder Management and use Advance simulation 60 seconds. Inspect btool/forwarding output and independent Search as required. Record the evidence answer; an answer alone cannot complete the exercise.

hints: Distinguish staged source, published catalog, downloaded app and running configuration.
Use a narrow target and the component that owns the change. Inspect failures before retrying.

references.purpose: Predict changes, apply and verify idempotency

checks.label: Verify actual forwarder lifecycle and delivery

questions.prompt: Which package version is installed and running?

feedback.success: Verified real simulated source, delivery and operational outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect component scope, activation, actual phone-home, latest run and independent search results.
